description: Generates one envelope stage: on a trigger it travels from the voltage at IN to the LEVEL voltage over the set duration

params.text: Sets how long the stage takes, 10ms to 10 seconds, with the centre position giving 1 second
Sets the voltage at which the generated stage ends, 0-10V
Sets the curvature of the stage; centred is a straight line, clockwise pushes the steep part towards the end and counter-clockwise towards the start, and the extremes are nearly square

inputs.text: The voltage a stage starts from, sampled when the trigger arrives, and passed straight to OUT while DEFER is high
A rising edge starts a stage from the voltage at IN; a rise during a stage abandons it and starts a new one, and rises are ignored while DEFER is high; it reads high above 1V
While this gate is high the IN signal passes straight to OUT and any stage in progress is abandoned; it reads high above 1V

outputs.text: Carries the generated stage, the IN voltage while DEFER is high, or the LEVEL voltage after a stage has completed
Carries a 1ms 10V pulse when a stage completes
Carries 10V while a stage is being generated or while DEFER is high, and 0V otherwise

notes: a knob turned while a stage runs takes effect at once, and the new value applies to the remainder of that stage
a stage runs only on a rising edge at the TRIG input; until the first one arrives OUT passes the IN voltage straight through, which is 0V with nothing patched
the module is mono: it reads the first channel of a polyphonic cable and ignores the rest, and every output carries a single channel

inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
